jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Financial Analyst
to support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance analysis.

The ideal candidate will have strong financial modelling skills, the ability to interpret complex financial data, and experience preparing insightful reports to support management decision-making.

Role Description

Prepare and analyse monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
Conduct budget-versus-actual analysis and identify key variances.
Develop and maintain financial models to support business decisions.
Analyse revenue, expenses, profitability, and operational performance.
Monitor financial KPIs and provide actionable recommendations.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and financial presentations.
Collaborate with Accounting and other departments to ensure data accuracy.
Identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities for cost optimisation.
Support business cases, feasibility studies, and financial performance reviews.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
Proven experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, or financial planning and analysis (FP&A).
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modelling and data analysis.
Strong knowledge of financial statements, financial reporting, and variance analysis.
Experience with ERP systems and Power BI is an advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to present financial insights clearly to management.
High attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
